- Try to have a lot of fun!

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdUplIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--92701aef7af516be4361993a7c4150fa9e22ea2d/image.png)

**Western Development Museum: The registration fee for this competition includes admission to the Western Development Museum for the competitors and their guests.** There will be a longer lunch break in the competition schedule so everyone can enjoy the museum. Learn more about the WDM at their website [here](https://wdm.ca/north-battleford/).

We ask attendees to limit themselves to two guest per competitor if possible so that we do not go over capacity limits for this venue which is 240 people.
Attendance is not required for the entire competition, however please arrive at least 15 minutes before your event's planned start time.
Please bring your own cubes for the events you are competing in.

**First Time Competitors:**
All newcomers must be familiar with the WCA Regulations before competing. There is a video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY&ab_channel=SpeedcubingCanada) for a basic rundown of a competition.

**Megaminx and Square-1:**
There will be no cutoff for Megaminx or Square-1 at this competition. The cumulative time limit for megaminx is 30 minutes. You may take over 10 minutes to do a single solve if you let your judge know beforehand. Megaminx is scheduled such that overflow into lunch is acceptable so everyone can get results.

**Draw prizes:** 
There will be draw prizes throughout the day to encourage competitors to stay after their round is done.

**Notice of Filming and Photography:**
Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

###### Español
¡Bienvenidos al Mololoa Open 2025, otra competencia en el hermoso estado de **Nayarit**!. Este evento emocionante y lleno de velocidad se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de Tepic los días sábado 17 y domingo 18 de mayo de 2025.

El Mololoa Open 2025 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en una variedad de eventos. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos participen y se diviertan.

Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Welcome to Mololoa Open 2025, another competition in the beautiful state of **Nayarit**! This exciting and high-speed event will take place in the city of Tepic on Saturday, May 17, and Sunday, May 18, 2025.

Mololoa Open 2025 will bring together cubers from across the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them with the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of events. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced professional, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to participate and have fun.

This competition is recognized as an official event by the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

items.name: Beginner & Blind Johannesburg 2025
items.information:
Welcome to Beginner & Blind Joburg 2025!

This competition focuses on blindfolded events on day 1 and the beginner friendly events on day 2. If you are only coming for the beginner friendly events, you don't have to be there on day 1, come join us for a weekend of cubing fun!

All competitors are expected to help out with volunteering - judging, running, and scrambling - please see the Competitor Information and FAQ tabs.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6ODYxNTIsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--07b6c24fa981292a6f4b6c84f7c1359bd733368b/IMG_8051.jpeg)

A huge thanks to [Cubestuff](https://www.cubestuff.co.za) for sponsoring this competition! Please support the  shop at the competition and check out their website for all your cubing needs.

items.name: Costa de la Luz Open 2025
Weston-super-Mare Spring 2025
items.information:
If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.

**Spectators may attend for free!**

[![UKCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0I0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1c7aaa67674e675ba6f477cf783142702a671457/UKCA_Logo.png)](https://www.ukca.org/)
[![Cuboss](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcUNBIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--055513fb6e7e1e8b0dbd1cb81eb908d714eb048b/cuboss-logo-600px.png)](https://cuboss.com/)

**PLEASE NOTE**: For this competition, there will be competitor limits for some events:
***- 4x4 Blindfolded and 5x5 Blindfolded: first 20 to register***
***- 6x6 and 7x7: first 40 to register***
Spaces are available on a first come first served basis. If you are amongst the first 20 (4BLD/5BLD) or 40 (6x6/7x7) to register for those events, you will get a space in them. If you are not within the first people registered, your registration for that event will be removed after the close of registration. However we will be keeping waiting list for these specific events in the case of dropouts before registration closes. Please only consider registering for these events if you are certain you would like to compete in them.

* All donations are appreciated and will go towards things such as venue fees, supplies and other competition expenses.

items.information:
* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. All competitors should read the MUST READ tab. 
* If this is your first competition, please be present for the competitor tutorial.

**Waitlist Procedure**

If registration fills up, we will place competitors on a waitlist. In the event a competitor drops from the competition, competitors will be accepted from the waitlist in the order payment was received. Competitors can be accepted from the waitlist until May 10, 2025 at 6:00 PM MDT.  You will receive a full refund if you are still on the waitlist by then.
